profile.name: Apoorv Chaurasia
profile.title: Specialist - Graphics Design
profile.summary: Specialist Graphic Designer at WSP with 12+ years of design experience, including 9+ years in employed roles across WSP, JLL, Deloitte Digital and Bhoomi Educational Consultancy. Combines hands-on design expertise with team leadership, brand stewardship and stakeholder collaboration.

introFacts.label: YEARS
introFacts.text: *12+ YEARS* OF DESIGN. THIS GAME IS HOW I TELL THE STORY.

introFacts.label: THE START
introFacts.text: I STARTED AS A *FREELANCE DESIGNER* AND NEVER STOPPED CREATING.

introFacts.label: FIRST JOB
introFacts.text: MY FIRST FULL-TIME ROLE: *BRANDS, WEBSITES* AND LEARNING MATERIAL.

introFacts.label: STORYTELLING
introFacts.text: I STUDIED *JOURNALISM*, SO I LEARNED TO DESIGN WITH STORIES.

introFacts.label: DELOITTE
introFacts.text: AT *DELOITTE DIGITAL*: NEWSPAPER CAMPAIGNS FOR THE US, UK AND AUSTRALIA.

introFacts.label: IIT DELHI
introFacts.text: I LEARNED *DESIGN, INNOVATION & ENTREPRENEURSHIP* AT IIT DELHI.

introFacts.label: JLL
introFacts.text: AT *JLL* I LED A DESIGN TEAM AND KEPT ONE BRAND CONSISTENT ACROSS US MARKETS.

introFacts.label: WSP
introFacts.text: AT *WSP* I DESIGN PRESENTATIONS FOR GLOBAL LEADERSHIP, INCLUDING THE CEO TEAM.

introFacts.label: MY CRAFT
introFacts.text: I TURN *COMPLEX IDEAS* INTO CLEAR, COMPELLING VISUAL STORIES.

bullets: Design presentations for global leadership, including the CEO team, supporting strategic communications and executive meetings.
Develop internal communication visuals for cross-functional teams to support employee engagement and information sharing.
Create marketing collateral supporting WSP India's brand visibility and business development.
Led a design team producing marketing materials and visual assets to support customer engagement.
Developed and maintained brand consistency across US markets, translating services into clear client-facing communications.
Partnered with cross-functional teams on a new brand identity and created presentations and marketing collateral.
Collaborated on newspaper advertising campaigns for US, UK and Australian clients, applying design thinking to visuals and messaging.
Worked with copywriters and the creative director to deliver on-brand illustrations, logos and final layouts.
Created branding, educational materials, website graphics and social content, from concept through final layout.
Translated client briefs into design concepts and refined work through feedback to meet project objectives.
